### EXPLORATION (diverge_label)

EXAMPLES OF DIFFERENT approaches (NOT LIMITED TO, PROPOSE YOUR OWN):
- **All-input fusion**: weighted additive evidence ↔ soft maximum ↔ multiplicative agreement ↔ piecewise risk regimes
- **False-clear safety**: intrusion-triggered floor ↔ looming-triggered floor ↔ approach-consistency rescue ↔ soft safety gates
- **Ranking quality**: monotone raw fusion ↔ saturating sigmoid map ↔ rank-preserving piecewise map ↔ interaction-enhanced ordering
- **Stability and controls**: quality attenuation ↔ quality-dependent shrinkage ↔ consistency gating ↔ bounded influence per feature
- **Multi-phase construction**: build monotone baseline then interactions ↔ safety floor then false-block suppression ↔ fuse then calibrate

### EXPLOITATION (refine_label)

EXAMPLES OF REFINEMENT strategies (NOT LIMITED TO, PROPOSE YOUR OWN):
- **Constant tuning**: coordinate-sweep existing weights ↔ refine gate thresholds ↔ tune slopes ↔ narrow promising ranges
- **False-clear refinement**: strengthen existing rescue floors ↔ soften activation boundaries ↔ verify every high-danger feature pattern
- **Ranking refinement**: reduce saturation ↔ rebalance interaction strengths ↔ preserve monotonicity ↔ separate near-tied scores
- **Stability and controls**: retune quality attenuation ↔ cap feature influence ↔ smooth piecewise joins ↔ strengthen consistency sensitivity
- **Final polish**: clip intermediate terms ↔ test boundary inputs ↔ reject non-finite paths ↔ simplify equivalent constants
